name: signal_lab
description: Backward evidence on the panel store: per-feature rank IC against later excess returns (overlap-corrected t, industry-neutral, halves, market regime), an event study of every print (surprise, reaction, run-up, drift, hold-through), and the later returns of each briefing-pack list. Numbers are evidence, not a gate: no list is filtered by them.

lists.name: courses
lists.sql: SELECT symbol, NULL AS close, bucket AS sub FROM suggested_courses

lists.name: movers
lists.sql: SELECT symbol, close, horizon || ':' || tail || ':' || COALESCE(up_class, down_class, '-') AS sub FROM movers_tails

lists.name: movers_class
lists.sql: SELECT DISTINCT symbol, close, tail || ':' || COALESCE(up_class, down_class, '-') AS sub FROM movers_tails

lists.name: movers_tail
lists.sql: SELECT symbol, close, horizon || ':' || tail AS sub FROM movers_tails
